taxonomic_note: Accepted species and native to Texas.
look_here_first: Start with the tiny compound leaves: a thornless densely branched shrub with odd-pinnate leaves made of several very small dull-green leaflets, sometimes on a narrowly winged rachis.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Edwards and Uvalde are exact project target-zone records. Val Verde is documented but outside the project target-county list and does not count. Hays/Purola is introduced and excluded.

approval_exception.reason: Correct stale PASS while preserving learner admission.

best_field_traits: odd-pinnate leaves with several very small leaflets
whitish flowers often before or with leaves
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Unlike R. aromatica, leaves are not merely three large fan-shaped leaflets; unlike thorny colima-type shrubs, R. microphylla lacks spines.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Many tiny leaflets on a thornless shrub are the fastest cue.

photo_note: Exact diagnostic imagery remains later enrichment.
